tool_args.rationale: Across eight observations, y is approximately 2.2 times u_now despite variation in x_now and mem_conv; H is narrowly clustered and shows no reliable trend. Fit the parsimonious static affine law numerically, avoiding another probe because the available batch already supports the required forecast regime.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its added rows reinforce near-proportional dependence on u_now, without identifying a meaningful horizon effect.
It predicts a systematic increase in y/u with H; the tightly clustered-horizon observations show no consistent trend, so a simpler static response is better supported.
With varying x_now, its transient term should create residual dependence on x_now; observed outputs instead track u_now closely.
Its nonlinear dependence on u_now is not supported by the nearly constant observed y/u ratios.
